title: Rich menace - Ready or not
htmlContent:
Rich menace delivers the perfect blend of feel good production and heavy writing on the new song “Ready or not”. The production captures you right away, with a bright tone that makes you want to dream, while his special vocal approach makes you feel the soul in the record, while he delivers the writing the world feels on this stellar record.
